title: Quiz: Context Compaction
limitations: Generated from concept pages; not yet reviewed by Luis.
Content may drift from source; verify against current main.

questions.scenario: What is the first layer of multi-layer compaction?
questions.explanation: Lossless pruning runs first — remove duplicates and empty messages without any information loss.

questions.scenario: The compaction circuit breaker trips. What does this mean?
options: Compaction has cycled max_compaction_cycles times without reaching threshold
questions.explanation: The circuit breaker prevents excessive compaction cycles.

options: Forces multi-layer compaction regardless of threshold
questions.explanation: /compact forces compaction by setting threshold to 0.

questions.scenario: What are recovery pointers used for?
options: Allowing retrieval of original content after truncation or summarization
questions.explanation: Recovery pointers are content hashes that allow retrieving the full original content.

options: Expensive context assembly by content hash
questions.explanation: It caches the result of context building, invalidating when input messages change.
